title: Merging the Adapter
description: The script that folds the adapter into a copy of the base weights, checks the answers still match, and saves a full-size model.

steps.description: The header comment says the script folds the adapter into a copy of the base weights and checks nothing changed. It sets `HF_HUB_OFFLINE`, imports the pieces from `infer_lora`, and sets the output path `./merged/makerspace-360m`.

It loads the model with the adapter attached, generates an answer before merging, then calls `merge_and_unload` to fold the adapter into the weights. The comment gives the update as `W` plus `(alpha/r) * B @ A`, then the adapter is dropped.
It prints the answer before and after to show they match, saves the merged model and tokenizer, then prints the total size of the saved folder next to the note that the adapter alone was a few MB.
The try block catches any error, prints a labeled message and the traceback, and exits with status 1.
